items.title: Ghosts and previews do not get draw levels, and relevel is O(n^2) per map change
items.evidence: **First half shipped 709d733**: `drive_ghost` inserted no `Paint`, so a preview drew at level 0 while every map spawn path reads `drawn_paints`; `bevy_emerge::paint_for_candidate` answers the same question for a row not yet in the map, and the ghost inserts it (tests/a_preview_draws_at_the_level_the_piece_lands_at.rs, 3 tests). **Still open**: `relevel_placements` compares every standing pair when the map changes (727 pieces, about 0.5 M pairs, each a separating-axis test), so a full-map edit pays a quadratic cost per change. A click cannot create the overlapping pair — `plan_placement` replaces same-layer blockers, so a clicked row's level is always 0. **Found this pass**: `drive_ghost`'s spawn in the headless harness is not reproducible run to run — three identical runs on one fixture gave one ghost, then none, then none — which is why the test pins the helper rather than a live ghost.

items.title: Cmd+Z does not take away a map that was just made: there is no map_remove operation
items.evidence: map_create declares Undo::None because `take_back` applies an inverse by calling the SAME operation's commit with it, and the faithful inverse of a create is a removal — which no operation carries. map removal exists only as the chooser's Delete row (chooser.rs confirm_delete_entry, std::fs::remove_file), outside the registry. An agent can therefore make a map and not unmake it.

items.title: Sanctuary's compositions are all Anchored, so the composed source and its variety measurement cannot run there

items.title: A new operation cannot be added without editing a protected test file: the UI entry-point tables live inside the parity test

must_fix.evidence: `tests/operations_have_two_front_ends.rs` holds `UI_ENTRY_POINTS` and `CHOOSER_ENTRY_POINTS` as `const`s (lines 70 and 77) and fails any registry operation missing from them. The loop brief makes `crates/*/tests/**` read-only, so `map_remove` (E-066) and every other new operation is unshippable by a loop pass — the pass stops and says so rather than editing the ratchet.

items.evidence: Proposed fix, for an evaluator pass: move both tables into product code as an exported constant (`ops::ui_entry_points()`), so an operation and its entry point are one commit in product code and the ratchet still bites on the product list. Blocker hit 2026-10-26 while attempting E-066.
